routing_rule: MLP if Mahalanobis distance < cutoff; QRF otherwise

cutoff_learning.selection_objective: minimum pooled observation-level RMSE; then MAE; then smaller threshold rank

mahalanobis_definition.preprocessing: median imputation + StandardScaler fitted on training domain

procedure_validation_note: AGH procedure was validated by fully nested polymer-group validation on the frozen manuscript population; this production cutoff is estimated from ordinary LOPO predictions of the current deployment population.
